info.name: GearUp Backend - Complete Assignment Scenarios
info.description: Run folders in numeric order. Set the admin credentials first, and clear run_id before each fresh run. Start the API and Stripe CLI. The hosted Stripe payment between checkout creation and PAID verification is a manual step.

item.name: 00 - Health
item.description: Verify the server before running scenarios.

item.name: 01 - Authentication Setup

item.name: 05 - Rental Happy Path

request.description: MANUAL STEP: open {{checkout_url}} and complete payment with a Stripe test card. Run `npm run stripe:webhook` so checkout.session.completed reaches the API.

exec: pm.test('Order is PAID after manual Stripe payment', () => pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('PAID'));

item.description: Run through confirmation and Checkout. After creating Checkout, manually open checkout_url and pay before continuing with PAID/PICKED_UP/RETURNED requests.

item.description: Verifies that cancelling a confirmed unpaid order expires its Checkout Session and fails the pending payment.

item.name: 10 - Stripe Webhook Reference

request.description: This placeholder proves unsigned/invalid webhook requests are rejected. Use `npm run stripe:webhook` for the real successful webhook scenario.

item.description: Do not expect an unsigned manual request to succeed. Real delivery must come from Stripe CLI or Stripe with a valid signature.

item.name: 11 - Logout
item.description: Run last because it clears authentication cookies. {{bearer_token_0s07}} variables are explicitly removed by the tests.
